title: Everything We Know About Prime Video's God of War Adaptation
excerpt:
Dave Bautista leads the series as Kratos, with two seasons ordered.
Prime Video has not announced an official premiere date.
body_md:
Prime Video's live-action God of War adaptation is moving forward after a series of creative and production changes. The television project is based on Sony's PlayStation franchise and centers on the relationship between Kratos and his young son Atreus. Two seasons have been ordered, but no official premiere date has been announced.

Dave Bautista is set to portray Kratos, a Spartan warrior with a violent past among the Greek gods who must now navigate the world of Norse mythology. Callum Vinson plays his ten-year-old son Atreus. After the death of Faye, their wife and mother, the two embark on a journey to scatter her ashes. The quest forces them to confront both external dangers and their difficult relationship, with each learning from the other.

The extensive supporting cast includes Mandy Patinkin as Odin, Ólafur Darri Ólafsson as Thor, Ed Skrein as Baldur, Teresa Palmer as Sif and Max Parker as Heimdall. Sonya Walger plays Freya. Alastair Duncan, who voiced Mimir in the games, reprises that role in live action. Jeff Gulka and Danny Woodburn are attached as the blacksmith brothers Sindri and Brok.

Deborah Ann Woll has also joined as Faye, a role she previously portrayed in God of War Ragnarök. Along with Duncan's casting, her involvement provides a direct link to the game's performances. Other announced actors include Louis Cunningham, Ben Chapple, Evelyn Miller and Island Austin in recurring roles connected to Thor's family and Asgard's warriors.

The series has experienced a complicated production history. Ryan Hurst was initially cast as Kratos but left after sustaining an injury during filming in 2026. Producers subsequently approached Bautista, whose agreement was finalized in late August. Pre-production began in late 2025, and the reported plan remains to film two seasons back to back, though production scheduling can change.

Behind the camera, Ronald D. Moore took over as showrunner after Rafe Judkins and his collaborators departed in 2024. Frederick E. O. Toye is attached to direct the first two episodes. Sony Pictures Television and Amazon MGM Studios are producing with PlayStation Productions and Moore's Tall Ship Productions.

The announced premise preserves the emotional core of the modern games: Kratos tries to teach his son how to become a better god, while Atreus challenges his father to become a better human being. It remains unclear exactly which game events will appear in the series or how they will be adapted. The two-season order should not be confused with a confirmed release schedule, and viewers should wait for an official premiere announcement.
